notes: ppl is non-finite (nan). kv_cache_compression_ratio derived theoretically from codebook encoding (16 bits FP16 / b_mse=3 bits per coordinate = 5.333x compression). β1a make_b_mse_hook_uniform is a round-trip hook (round-trip K/V preserves shape/dtype for PPL measurement correctness), so this ratio is computed from b_mse rather than measured from pre/post past_key_values byte sizes. R12 v1.1 §6.1's pre/post-bytes mechanism is vacuous for round-trip hooks; a future R12 v1.2 amendment will clarify the field semantics.
